summary: QuickEntryFindStudent is an ASP.NET web form for searching and selecting students for placement. The screen allows users to filter students by last name, first name, student number, and consent program. Results are presented in a paged grid, allowing users to select, add, or clear student selections. The workflow integrates JavaScript operations for selection, error/warning display, and validation. The system enforces a minimum search criteria and manages program-specific warnings.
purpose: To enable authorized users (such as agency staff) to efficiently search, filter, and select students for placement or enrollment, ensuring they meet program and consent criteria before adding them to a placement workflow.

fields.name: txtLast
fields.description: Student last name (string, required for search)

fields.name: txtFirst
fields.description: Student first name (string, required for search)

fields.name: ddConsentProgram
fields.description: Program filter (int, required for search, selected program for consent)

fields.name: txtStudentIDs
fields.description: Comma-separated list of selected student IDs

fields.name: includeNoConsent
fields.description: Boolean to include students without consent

workflows.name: Search and Select Students
steps: User enters search criteria (last name, first name, student number, consent program).
User clicks 'Search'; validation ensures at least one search field is populated.
System displays student search results in a paged grid.
User may use 'Select All', 'Select None', or manually check students.
User clicks 'Add Selected Students' to transfer selected students to placement workflow.
Program warning is displayed if consent program filter does not match placement requirements.
User can clear criteria or close the window.

business_rules: At least one search field (last name, first name, student number) must be populated for search.
Selected consent program must match placement requirements or trigger a warning.
Students without required consent may be optionally included based on the flag.
validations: CustomValidator ensures that at least one search field is filled.
Search triggers only if validation passes.
Error and warning panels display messages regarding search or selection failures.
calculations: Count of selected students is updated on the parent window.
Number of matches shown in the grid is dynamically updated.
conditions: Program warning panel is displayed if selected consent program differs from placement program.
Error panel is shown for validation failures or unexpected conditions.
system_behavior: Handles search operations and result paging.
Manages client-side JavaScript for error/warning display, selection handling, and search reset.
Updates parent window with selected students and their count.
Registers script includes and startup scripts for page operations.
dependencies: Resource localization for labels and button text.
Dropdown utility functions for selection and value handling.
exceptions: Invalid or missing search criteria triggers validation errors.
Unexpected nulls in selection controls cause early exits in JavaScript.
